nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel entry point for the wiki-compiler package, re-exporting the WikiCompiler class, synthesizer utilities, Obsidian/Notion export helpers, and all associated TypeScript types.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure re-export barrel with 31 named exports and no local logic.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration for the wiki-compiler package, defining compilation options plus include/exclude paths.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Package manifest for the @waggle/worker workspace package, declaring its ESM exports, scripts, and runtime dependencies.

nodes.name: waggle-dispatch.test.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest unit tests for the WaggleDispatch handler, using a makeDeps factory to inject mocked dependencies and verify dispatch routing logic.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration for the worker package, with project references to shared upstream packages and include/exclude paths.

nodes.name: playwright-e2e.config.ts
nodes.summary: Minimal Playwright configuration for API-level end-to-end tests, targeting the sidecar server endpoint without browser interaction.

nodes.name: playwright.config.ts
nodes.summary: Full Playwright configuration for browser-driven end-to-end and visual regression tests, defining multiple projects for Chromium, Firefox, and visual tests with screenshot comparison settings.
nodes.languageNotes: Configures multiple Playwright projects (chromium, firefox, visual) with baseURL targeting the Vite dev server.

nodes.name: analyze-ensemble-baseline.mjs
nodes.summary: Analysis script computing inter-rater agreement statistics (Fleiss kappa, Cohen's kappa) across judge ensemble outputs to establish a quality baseline for the memory benchmark.

nodes.name: analyze-task-2-2-closeout.mjs
nodes.summary: Closeout analysis script for benchmark task 2.2, computing Fleiss/Cohen kappa statistics and category-specific failure-mode breakdowns across ensemble judge results.

nodes.name: build-sidecar.mjs
nodes.summary: Build script that compiles and bundles the Fastify sidecar Node.js server using esbuild, producing a standalone binary embedded in the Tauri desktop app.

nodes.name: build-task-2-2-dataset.mjs
nodes.summary: Dataset construction script that extracts conversation turns and anchor-based excerpts from the LoCoMo benchmark to generate evaluation instances for benchmark task 2.2.

nodes.name: bundle-native-deps.mjs
nodes.summary: Build script that copies native binary dependencies (e.g., better-sqlite3 node addons, sqlite-vec) into the Tauri sidecar bundle directory.

nodes.name: bundle-node.mjs
nodes.summary: Build script that bundles the Node.js runtime and sidecar output into a self-contained binary for Tauri packaging.

nodes.name: check-no-invalid-snapshots.mjs
nodes.summary: CI validation script that walks the source tree and scans all TypeScript/JavaScript files for toMatchInlineSnapshot calls with empty or placeholder content, failing the build if any are found.

nodes.name: check-sidecar-resources.mjs
nodes.summary: Pre-build validation script that checks required sidecar resource files and native binaries are present before the Tauri bundling step.

nodes.name: deep-clean-and-recompile.mjs
nodes.summary: Maintenance script that performs a nuclear clean of all dist, node_modules, and TypeScript build info files before triggering a full ordered rebuild of all monorepo packages.

nodes.name: evolution-hypothesis-rejudge-gemini.mjs
nodes.summary: Benchmark re-judging script that calls Gemini models via OpenRouter with exponential back-off retry to re-evaluate evolution hypothesis outputs and produce updated scoring results.

nodes.name: evolution-hypothesis-resume.mjs
nodes.summary: Resumable evolution hypothesis evaluation script that fills model-output arms using OpenRouter, runs multi-judge scoring with retry logic, and writes a structured Markdown report.

nodes.name: evolution-hypothesis.mjs
nodes.summary: Main evolution hypothesis experiment script implementing GEPA-style prompt evolution with multi-arm LLM evaluation, judge ensemble scoring, and detailed Markdown report generation.
nodes.languageNotes: 781-line orchestrator that drives the full GEPA prompt-evolution pipeline via OpenRouter + Anthropic APIs with checkpoint saving.

nodes.name: harvest-and-compile.mjs
nodes.summary: Utility script that invokes the Waggle harvest pipeline to ingest exported conversation data and compile it into the wiki-compiler output format.

nodes.name: inspect-fresh-claude-export.mjs
nodes.summary: Diagnostic script that reads and summarises a Claude conversation export ZIP, printing conversation counts, date ranges, and sample entries for manual verification.

nodes.name: judge-calibration.mjs
nodes.summary: Judge calibration harness that loads the project's judge module, runs ensemble or single-model judging on labelled benchmark instances, and emits a JSON results file with per-instance scores and cost tracking.

nodes.name: nuclear-rebuild.mjs
nodes.summary: Deep-clean rebuild script that purges all build artifacts and node_modules across the entire monorepo, then performs a full reinstall and sequential package build.

nodes.name: persona-reactor-workflow.mjs
nodes.summary: Workflow orchestration script that runs multi-turn LLM persona evaluation trials via the agent loop and aggregates per-dimension scores into a summary report.

nodes.name: qwen-stability-matrix.mjs
nodes.summary: Stability matrix experiment script that runs Qwen models through a combinatorial grid of token budgets and prompt shapes via LiteLLM, classifies output outcomes (safe/loop/truncated), and renders a detailed Markdown + CSV report.
